description: Principle checks run over code digests (and code blocks pasted into conversations). A hit becomes a 'violates' fact (principle -> file:line) and an improvement item in backlog.md. Detector kinds are a closed set implemented in code; patterns and thresholds are data.

message.en: A literal table of {n} string entries in code: lexicon/policy data belongs in a data file
message.pl: Tablica {n} literałów w kodzie: leksykon/polityka powinny być danymi

message.en: Dispatch on a provider/platform name: ask can(resource, capability, constraints) instead
message.pl: Rozgałęzienie po nazwie providera/platformy: zamiast tego can(resource, capability, constraints)

message.en: Silent 'except: pass': log at least at debug level with exc_info
message.pl: Ciche 'except: pass': co najmniej log.debug(..., exc_info=True)

message.en: JSON written in place: write to .tmp and rename
message.pl: Zapis JSON w miejscu: zapisz do .tmp i zrób rename

message.en: Telemetry call: the default is no telemetry
